summary: The web reads native user turns that re-deliver the same Fractal message as one prompt with a count, by delivery link; the gateway now negotiates conversation-delivery-links.v1

replay.detail: Web UI and gateway headers only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: The web gateway adds conversation-delivery-links.v1 to client reads and WebSocket upgrades, so native user turns carry the optional `delivers` link. Daemons without the capability ignore it and the web then collapses nothing. Only Claude's verified transcript binding produces the link today.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores separate prompt rows and the previous feature header.
